requirement.description: UnboundLocalError in parse_obj function due to undefined variable i_val in test_multiple_comments and test_simple_comment test cases. The variable i_val is referenced before assignment in the parsing logic.
requirement.contract: Fix the UnboundLocalError by ensuring all variables are initialized before use. Specifically, the variable i_val in the parse_obj function needs to be properly initialized before being referenced in the parsing logic for comments.

requirement.description: Missing sample PDF files causing FileNotFoundError in setUpClass methods of test_simplefile.py and test_updating.py. Tests cannot run because required sample files are not present in ./samples/ directory.
requirement.contract: Ensure that all required sample PDF files (add_text_annotation.pdf and simple_text_string.pdf) are available in the ./samples/ directory or adjust test setup to handle missing files gracefully.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of incomplete tokens in next_token function. The test cases test_name_incomplete and test_integer_incomplete expect None as the third element of the tuple when tokens are incomplete, but the current implementation doesn't correctly handle this case.
requirement.contract: Update the next_token function to correctly return None as the third element of the tuple when processing incomplete tokens such as names and integers at the end of input.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of stream token detection in next_token function. The test_stream test expects a specific return format but the current implementation doesn't correctly handle stream detection.
requirement.contract: Fix the stream token detection logic in next_token function to properly identify stream markers and return the correct tuple format.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of Unicode text strings in test_literal_utf16be test case. The function text_string fails to correctly decode UTF-16BE encoded strings with BOM.
requirement.contract: Improve the text_string function to correctly handle UTF-16BE encoded strings with BOM by properly detecting and handling the Byte Order Mark.
